High grade film capacitors and resistors picked for their superior sound and response Completely true bypass Battery connection and 9v power jack (barrel plug like Boss) Power draw: 23mA Completely original design Switchable between two completely independent clipping circuits, pure fuzz or a fuzz like distortion Transistors are hand selected for superior tone and response 2.5″ x 4.5″ x 1.5″ (63.5mm x 114.3mm x 38.1mm) – height excludes knobs and switches The Wampler Pedals Velvet Fuzz Pedal A guitar effects pedal is the ultimate tool for a guitarist. Allowing him or her to create new sounds and add effects to their music. However, guitar pedals are often complicated to use, difficult to set up, and can be difficult to understand. Handmade With Quality Components Though there are many guitar effects pedals available today. Most of them are over-priced and not worth the money you spend on them. The Velvet Fuzz is handmade with top quality components. Designed to give you a fuzz tone that is rich in texture and harmonics. It is equipped with a true bypass switch that preserves your tone, when it is switched off. This means that you will not hear any signal degradation when it is switched off. A Great Company Wampler Pedals is a brand of guitar effects that is known for their boutique quality. The Velvet Fuzz is great for adding a gritty, fuzzy sound to your tone. Producing a sound that is similar to the original vintage fuzz pedals. It was designed to be a vintage pedal with modern updates. The quality of the product is top-notch. This can be easily seen by its hand-wired components and the use of true bypass. Adjustable And Affordable Wampler Pedal's Velvet Fuzz is the result of years of research and development for the ultimate fuzz pedal with the most flexibility and versatility. The goal was to create a fuzz that could be used with any instrument, from a bass guitar to a trumpet to a violin, and it would still sound like the instrument it was intended for. This has been achieved by creating a fuzz that is completely adjustable, and can be adjusted for all instruments, from a bass guitar to an electro-acoustic. It is also highly versatile in that it can be used in both standard guitar and bass guitar applications, and is also able to be used as a standalone distortion pedal. It is also the first fuzz that is controllable by an expression pedal, allowing for even greater flexibility when it comes to creating the perfect fuzz sound for any instrument. The Verdict The Wampler Pedals Velvet Fuzz gives you an “old school” sound at an affordable price. The sound is best described as “heavy” and “gritty”. The Velvet Fuzz is designed to give you the sound of the classic Fender-style Big Muff. It is a high quality, hand-built, analog pedal. That will give you the same sound as the classic distortion pedal, but at a fraction of the cost. sources.excerpt: Wampler Pedals Velvet Fuzz User Manual | 2 pages Manuals Directory ManualsDir.com - online owner manuals library Search Directory Brands Wampler Pedals manuals Audio Velvet Fuzz Manual Wampler Pedals Velvet Fuzz User Manual F u z z, Velvet fuzz Text mode Original mode Advertising Velvet Fuzz TM F U Z Z TM Known for his ability to recreate Amps in Boxes, Brian Wampler recently became fascinated with the sound of a classic pedal through a famous amp. One of the most obvious is a fuzz pedal into a full EL34 driven stack, the kind of tones that are a foundation strong enough to build “The Wall” on. He wanted the smoothness AND the aggression of the fuzz, the power of the stack and most importantly, bringing those tones to life through your amp. This led him to a place he wasn’t expecting. As soon as the circuit jumped to life he found himself squeezing solo tones that could easily leave you numb, albeit really comfortably... In fact, it could send you right over the edge of the Cliffs of Dover! The chords remained clear with ALL the strings singing through, it reacted really well when the volume on the guitar was turned down... Interesting. With this as a base tone, there became the challenge to make it versatile enough for fuzz fans, and distortion fans, but retain the character flavor the pedal is already giving. Utilizing several Wampler tricks and one or two completely unique approaches, Brian added the voicing switch to give you the option of a more fuzz friendly tone or a more distortion tone. With the fuzz side being bigger and looser, and the dirt side being tighter and brighter, this pedal works wonderfully if you want to retain your tone yet smash it up in the best possible way . So, if you are are lusting over the sweetest sustaining fuzz or the dirtiest destroyed fuzz that can border on distortion, the Velvet Fuzz is for you - there is no other fuzz like it.. To get the most out of your new pedal, you'll want to become very familiar with the controls. The Velvet Fuzz has three controls and 2 voicing options. Each control will effect the others so it’s good initially to try and see how each effects the others. For example, the brightness knob reacts a bit differently in the BIG position than it does in the TIGHT position. Bypass Switch – Simple enough, this footswitch is wired up for true bypass switching to ensure that you don't have anything in the way when you disable the pedal. The LED indicator light will show that when the pedal is activated. Volume – This controls the output level of the pedal. It works just like the volume knob on your guitar or your amp. As you raise the FUZZ knob, and depending on how you adjust the BRIGHTNESS control and switches, you may need to raise or lower them to have the same output level. That's perfectly normal. We suggest that initially you find where “unity” volume is (when the affected sound level is the same as the unaffected sound level) and work from there.
